headline: Reserve Bank of Australia Expected to Raise Cash Rate by 25 Bps on Inflation
summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia is projected to deliver a 25 basis point interest rate hike at its November meeting as the inflation outlook worsens.
why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets national monetary policy, influencing commercial borrowing rates, the Australian dollar, and economic activity.

impacts.name: RBA Cash Rate
impacts.why: The central bank is expected to increase its benchmark cash rate by 25 basis points.
